title: diplolepis boerhaviifolia
intro: Diplolepis boerhaviifolia, commonly known as Boerhavia, is a medicinal plant that belongs to the Nyctaginaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Diplolepis boerhaviifolia include analgesic and anti-oxidative activities, which contribute to its use in treating pain and oxidative stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's extracts.
